Now I have everything needed for a comprehensive answer. Here is my complete findings:

---

## Detailed Answer: Derived Memo Metadata (Payload)

### What is the derived metadata?

Each memo carries a `Payload` field of type `MemoPayload` (defined in the store protobuf), which contains content-derived metadata that the user never sets directly. The protobuf definition is at:

**`/bench/home/work/proto/store/memo.proto`, lines 7-29:**

The `MemoPayload` has three fields:
1. **`property`** (`MemoPayload.Property`, lines 15-23) -- boolean flags and a title:
   - `has_link` (bool) -- whether the content contains a markdown link
   - `has_task_list` (bool) -- whether the content contains a GFM task checkbox
   - `has_code` (bool) -- whether the content contains a code block or code span
   - `has_incomplete_tasks` (bool) -- whether any task checkbox is unchecked
   - `title` (string) -- the text of the first H1 heading, if the first block-level element is an H1

2. **`tags`** (repeated string, line 10) -- all `#tag` tokens found in the markdown content, deduplicated

3. **`location`** (`MemoPayload.Location`, lines 24-28) -- this is user-set, not derived from content

Additionally, the API layer computes a **`snippet`** field on the fly (not persisted in the payload) -- a plain-text summary truncated to 64 characters at a word boundary.

### Where is it computed?

The core computation lives in **`/bench/home/work/server/runner/memopayload/runner.go`, function `RebuildMemoPayload` (lines 74-88)**. This function:
1. Initializes the payload if nil (line 76-77)
2. Calls `markdownService.ExtractAll([]byte(memo.Content))` (line 80) to parse the markdown in a single pass
3. Assigns the extracted `data.Tags` to `memo.Payload.Tags` (line 85)
4. Assigns the extracted `data.Property` to `memo.Payload.Property` (line 86)

The actual extraction logic is in **`/bench/home/work/internal/markdown/markdown.go`, method `ExtractAll` (lines 356-422)**. This performs a single AST walk over the goldmark-parsed markdown and collects:
- **Tags** (lines 377-378): Any `TagNode` (custom AST node for `#tag` syntax) that is not inside a link/image
- **Mentions** (lines 379-381): Any `MentionNode` (for `@username` syntax) -- extracted but not stored in payload
- **Property.Title** (lines 384-389): If the first block-level child of the document is an H1 heading, its plain text is extracted
- **Property.HasLink** (lines 393-394): Set true when a `KindLink` node is found
- **Property.HasCode** (lines 396-397): Set true when a `KindCodeBlock`, `KindFencedCodeBlock`, or `KindCodeSpan` is found
- **Property.HasTaskList** and **Property.HasIncompleteTasks** (lines 399-405): Set when a `TaskCheckBox` node (GFM extension) is found; `HasIncompleteTasks` is true if any checkbox is unchecked

The **snippet** is computed separately at response-conversion time by `getMemoContentSnippet` at **`/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go`, lines 83-90**, which calls `s.MarkdownService.GenerateSnippet([]byte(content), 64)`. The `GenerateSnippet` method is at **`/bench/home/work/internal/markdown/markdown.go`, lines 264-346** -- it walks the AST, extracts plain text (skipping code blocks), and truncates at a word boundary to 64 characters.

### Which operations trigger recomputation?

There are exactly **two RPC operations** that call `RebuildMemoPayload` inline, plus one batch mechanism:

1. **CreateMemo** -- `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go`, line 108:
   ```go
   if err := memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload(ctx, create, s.MarkdownService); err != nil {
   ```
   Called before the memo is persisted to the database. This also covers **CreateMemoComment** since that method internally calls `CreateMemo` (see `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go`, line 56).

2. **UpdateMemo** -- `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go`, lines 447-449:
   ```go
   if err := memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload(ctx, memo, s.MarkdownService); err != nil {
   ```
   Called only when the `"content"` field is in the update mask (line 436: `if path == "content"`). Other update paths (visibility, pinned, state, timestamps, location, attachments, relations) do not trigger payload recomputation.

3. **Batch rebuild (Runner.RunOnce)** -- `/bench/home/work/server/runner/memopayload/runner.go`, lines 27-72:
   This iterates all memos in batches of 100, calls `RebuildMemoPayload` on each, and persists the updated payload back to the database. However, this runner is **not currently wired into the server startup** -- the `startBackgroundRunners` method in `/bench/home/work/server/server.go` only starts the S3 presign runner. The `memopayload.Runner` exists as infrastructure for manual/migration use but is not automatically invoked.

### Summary of what the computation extracts

| Extracted field | Source in content | Where detected |
|---|---|---|
| `tags` ([]string) | `#tag` tokens (custom parser extension) | `markdown.go:377-378` |
| `property.has_link` (bool) | Markdown link nodes `[text](url)` | `markdown.go:393-394` |
| `property.has_code` (bool) | Fenced code blocks, code blocks, inline code spans | `markdown.go:396-397` |
| `property.has_task_list` (bool) | GFM task checkboxes `- [ ]` / `- [x]` | `markdown.go:399-400` |
| `property.has_incomplete_tasks` (bool) | Unchecked task checkboxes `- [ ]` | `markdown.go:402-405` |
| `property.title` (string) | First block element if it is an H1 heading | `markdown.go:384-389` |
| `snippet` (string, not persisted) | Plain text summary, max 64 chars, word-boundary truncated | `memo_service_webhooks.go:83-90`, `markdown.go:264-346` |
